summary: Avoid worktree lease processes for unchanged render output

compatibility.detail: Render passes still plan all members and union shared Git excludes. Only members needing output or legacy cleanup acquire deletion admission; unchanged plans publish receipts without committing. Mutating members revalidate their workspace and reprepare output under the lease; a changed plan is deferred rather than applied with stale graph decisions. Observed worktree identities survive through start admission even if reclamation removes Git pointers. Starts refuse missing workspaces rather than recreating a checkout as a plain directory. Leases remain held through publication and runtime initialization.

recovery.detail: No data migration; binary rollback remains available.
